title: Write a type guide
summary: Haskell: Write a type guide. Try a decimal and read the type error.
introduction: A type signature describes inputs and results. Int -> Int means a whole number in and out.
learningObjectives: Write a type guide with Haskell
Try a decimal and read the type error

blocks.text: Install GHC. Save one example as lesson.hs and run runghc lesson.hs. Keep any definitions above main in the same file.

blocks.title: Write a type guide
blocks.code:
twice :: Int -> Int
twice n = n * 2
main = print (twice 4)

blocks.text: The signature expects an Int and returns an Int. The definition doubles it.
Try a decimal and read the type error.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The definition must agree with its type signature.
